comparison.objective: Cut a wire-duct cover to length and snap it over an open run, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Length fitting, cutting, long-part alignment, and distributed latching versus fine tool insertion, rotary adjustment, counterholding, and witness-torque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Duct run fully covered with a fitted, latched cover versus two quantified safe impacts and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: Cover fitting/latching does not test adjustable energy absorption. Body and specs are absent, so fit, cut, and latch tolerances are missing.
